    <name>discord</name>
    <description>Discord ops via the message tool (channel=discord).</description>
    <location>~/AppData\Roaming\npm\node_modules\openclaw\skills\discord\SKILL.md</location>
  </skill>

    <name>gh-issues</name>
    <description>Fetch GitHub issues, spawn sub-agents to implement fixes and open PRs, then monitor and address PR review comments.     <location>~/AppData\Roaming\npm\node_modules\openclaw\skills\gh-issues\SKILL.md</location>
  </skill>
  <skill>
    <name>github</name>
    <description>GitHub operations via `gh` CLI: issues, PRs, CI runs, code review, API queries. Use when: (1) checking PR status or CI, (2) creating/commenting on issues, (3) listing/filtering PRs or issues, (4) viewing run logs. NOT for: complex web UI interactions requiring manual browser flows (use browser tooling when available), bulk operations across many repos (script with gh api), or when gh auth is not configured.</description>
    <location>~/AppData\Roaming\npm\node_modules\openclaw\skills\github\SKILL.md</location>
  </skill>

    <name>healthcheck</name>
    <description>Host security hardening and risk-tolerance configuration for OpenClaw deployments.     <location>~/AppData\Roaming\npm\node_modules\openclaw\skills\healthcheck\SKILL.md</location>
  </skill>

    <name>node-connect</name>
    <description>Diagnose OpenClaw node connection and pairing failures for Android, iOS, and macOS companion apps.     <location>~/AppData\Roaming\npm\node_modules\openclaw\skills\node-connect\SKILL.md</location>
  </skill>

    <name>skill-creator</name>
    <description>Create, edit, improve, or audit AgentSkills.     <location>~/AppData\Roaming\npm\node_modules\openclaw\skills\skill-creator\SKILL.md</location>

compactionCheckpoints.summary:
## Goal
The user is trying to implement a machine learning model for image classification using Python.

## Constraints & Preferences
- The model should be able to classify images into 10 different categories.
- The user wants to use the TensorFlow library.
- The code should be optimized for performance.

## Progress
### Done
- [x] Set up the project structure and installed required libraries.
- [x] Loaded the dataset using the TensorFlow Dataset API.

### In Progress
- [ ] Implemented the convolutional neural network (CNN) architecture.

### Blocked
- None

## Key Decisions
- **Use of transfer learning**: The user decided to use a pre-trained model as the base for their CNN, which will be fine-tuned on their dataset.
  Brief rationale: This decision was made to speed up development and improve performance.

## Next Steps
1. Implement the CNN architecture using the pre-trained model as the base.
2. Train the model on the dataset and evaluate its performance.
3. Fine-tune the model for better results.

## Critical Context
- The user's dataset is stored in a directory called "data" with 10 subdirectories, each representing one of the categories.
- The dataset consists of images in JPEG format.
- The pre-trained model used as the base is MobileNetV2.
